picks.excerpt: Brown University researchers built a physics-informed neural network that predicts how controlled-release materials dispense drugs, potentially slashing development time for therapeutic patches, bandages and implants by up to 94%.
picks.rationale: Physics-informed ML directly accelerates drug-delivery materials design — high actionability with a concrete 94% development-time cut. Bio/materials sub-domain.

picks.excerpt: Technion's BetaDescribe is an AI system that translates raw protein sequences into natural-language descriptions, generating evidence-based hypotheses about the functions of otherwise-uncharacterized proteins for drug discovery and biotech.
picks.rationale: Novel protein-to-text model surfaces functions of uncharacterized proteins, feeding real drug-discovery hypotheses. Distinct protein sub-domain.

picks.excerpt: An international team at GSI/FAIR trained a deep neural network (RHINE) to model r-process heating in neutron-star mergers, letting simulations of how the universe forges its heaviest elements run far faster and more accurately.
picks.rationale: Neural network makes heavy-element nucleosynthesis simulations faster and more accurate — a concrete method advance in astrophysics from a credible GSI/FAIR team.

picks.excerpt: From structural biology to particle physics, AI systems increasingly deliver results of remarkable power and accuracy — yet even their creators struggle to explain how they reach them, raising the question of what counts as understanding in science.
picks.rationale: Credible, very fresh (07-14) piece on how AI is reshaping scientific method and the meaning of understanding — physics/epistemology angle from a distinct outlet.

picks.excerpt: Anthropic's 'Jacobian lens' reveals a hidden 'J-space' inside Claude Opus 4.6 — words that shape a model's upcoming output without appearing in it — offering the clearest glimpse yet into how LLMs represent and weigh concepts internally.
picks.rationale: Concrete interpretability discovery into how LLMs internally represent concepts — cognition/AI-science sub-domain, top-tier outlet, high novelty.
